score_contract.category_group: All objects of a category inside and settled in one basket, with other categories excluded; one/two/three completed basket groups
score_contract.temporal_semantics: Transition scoring: retained latest reached state; each native step tests only the next transition and advances at most one state. It is NOT a recomputed final-frame group count.

interpretation: Physical delivery of one object does not guarantee partial score when other same-category objects remain outside.

Both grippers must pass the open threshold WHEN a score transition is checked. Later gripper closure does not erase an already reached transition score. Final gripper state alone cannot explain the episode score.

The four RPC methods do not expose a home/return-to-origin operation; code candidates may not be equipped to satisfy full-success conditions from the documented API alone. This is a capability/contract limitation to inspect, not proof that all primitive use is impossible.
use: Add explicit public completion requirements to later feedback only after stage1 frozen comparison finishes; do not alter current sampling requests.
